body.x: Tiger AI Co., Ltd. (CEO Ha Daesu) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will occur from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas. The company will introduce "TIGER GYM" at the K-Startup Pavilion.

Tiger AI specializes in AI technology for motion data analysis. It offers data collection, processing, and AI-based services through advanced algorithms and analytical methods. With its expertise, the company has developed precise motion measurement systems that minimize errors during data collection and produce high-quality labeled datasets.

Recognized as a Data Voucher provider for three consecutive years and a participant in the Global Healthcare Week, Tiger AI has established itself as a leader in healthcare data, successfully collaborating with various organizations and institutions.

The company’s comprehensive motion data and processing technology database has supported projects with institutions like Silla University and MedLab. Building on these successes, Tiger AI has expanded its reach through collaborative projects with global partners and has exported motion recognition solutions and kiosks to Vietnam and Indonesia.
At CES 2025, Tiger AI will debut "TIGER GYM," an AI-driven exercise posture correction service aimed at the fitness-focused 20s and 30s demographic.

TIGER GYM monitors users’ exercise movements using Tiger AI’s proprietary motion analysis and video review technology. The platform identifies incorrect postures, converts the data into visual formats, and automatically sends flagged videos to experts for feedback. Users also benefit from interactive features, such as rewards for achieving activity goals and mixed-reality sports game content, where completing specific exercises upgrades their virtual character.

Tiger AI is also planning further expansion into the ASEAN digital healthcare and fitness markets, particularly targeting Vietnam. The company aims to strengthen its network within these regions, aligning with its global vision of advancing fitness and healthcare technology.

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
